subtopic: Composite Index Column Ordering and Covering Indexes
question_text: [Relational & NoSQL Database Design & Indexing - Q57] Given a B-tree composite index on `(status, created_at, user_id)`, which query CANNOT take advantage of the index's leading keys?
answer_explanation: B-tree composite indexes can only be traversed using a contiguous prefix of columns starting from the leftmost column. A query omitting `status` cannot seek the index tree.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: C. Rationale: B-tree composite indexes can only be traversed using a contiguous prefix of columns starting from the leftmost column. A query omitting `status` cannot seek the index tree.
